method: 12 s board windows chased to 180 s. CPU summaries exclude the first stale/partial 1 s diagnostic; counters include all 12 s. Restore latest project/effect state and transport each time. Candidates incremental; final removes rejected experiments. No QEMU or full-song soak.
preserved: existing libxmp voice policy and 128-voice ceiling
original fixed mixer part boundaries and arithmetic
user project, library and latest effect settings

decisions.change: Prepare current tick tail in a host block without player work; never speculatively run the next tick.
Common unfiltered mono linear kernels unrolled 4x plus exact-zero output branch. Slower on board; both reverted.
Optional 8 KiB FAST tick buffer with large-tick fallback. Gain inconclusive; scarce RAM returned.
Per-line contiguous recurrence and accumulation in bounded 64-frame chunks; arithmetic unchanged.
Optional ABI 1.3 host fork/join of independent reverb channels, sharing existing worker. Serial fallback when unavailable/busy/nested.

limits: Remaining per-block deadline overruns in both dry and wet windows.

renderUsMax in diagnostics is cumulative within its boot, not a per-window maximum.
